elsewhere.note: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it…
Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. The Arabians also brought him flocks, seven thousand seven hundred rams, and seven…
the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.
